summary: Completed self-check verification of RFC design document against all quality criteria.
evidence: Problem statement focuses strictly on business and platform impact (uncontrolled traffic, 50k req/min incident, 2 AM manual intervention, unmonetized tiers) rather than jumping to solutions.
Both alternatives considered (In-Memory per pod, Redis Fixed Window) have clear legitimate benefits and non-strawman tradeoffs.
Risks section includes the risk of doing nothing alongside concrete technical mitigations (fail-open logic, regional co-location).
Open questions section explicitly acknowledges boundaries of current scope (enterprise dynamic overrides, unauthenticated defaults).
